choice.key_rule: caller keys come from the request; internal slot labels A..P are positional, not semantic
choice.unsupported_extension: choice over 17..255 options is a later extension with separate validation

confidence.note: Jev's documented primitive-specific confidence formula is NOT implemented; it stays absent until verified against the reference implementation
confidence.raw_max_probability: reported as the maximum probability among the active slots

s1_definition.note: a chat response with thinking disabled is not a trained S1 model and is not reported as one

score.rubric_rule: exactly six ordered rubric descriptions are required and appear in the prompt
score.unsupported_extension: arbitrary 2..10 rubric levels are a later extension with separate validation

slots.inactive_slot_rule: masked before normalisation and returned as exactly 0.0

stage: S1 buildout (protocol and data preparation tooling); no runtime integration

target.uniform_policy: kept; uniformity is not a drop reason
